# ECREA - European Communication Research and Education Association

> ECREA is a leading European academic association fostering communication research, education, and professional development through conferences, publications, and collaborative research initiatives.

ECREA serves as a hub for communication scholars and researchers across Europe, organizing major conferences, managing research sections, and publishing academic work. The organization supports both established and early-career researchers through membership benefits, funding opportunities, and professional development programs.
